notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.Cradle of the Sun.
You control at least three creatures.
description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun's second ability by tapping it, adding {G} for each creature you control.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc // Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
